title: Great app, can be better!
body:
I have been looking for a good way to track my days holistically. And I landed upon Awesome Habits, and it really is awesome. The clean and minimal UI, the grid view, the statistics visualisation, even tracking quitting a bad habit; everything is great. I also love the fact that they have provided a lifetime access tier because personally, I’m not really a monthly subscription kinda person. However there are few areas where the app can be improved for user experience:
1. There’s no way to list and track one time activities or tasks for the day. I would not want to create a one time habit for my daily to-dos. And this is my biggest issue.
2. No way to journal - On some days I have really hoped that the app could have let me jot down a couple things at the end of the day.
3. I wish there was a place to record my weight daily, that would have been great. And then that could also maybe show up in a graph. And tracking weight is just a use case, it could be any number that I would want to track.

title: Best Habit tracking app on App Store
body:
TL;DR : If you are a new user, looking for a good habit tracking app, don’t think much, go for Awesome Habits. It is the best Habit tracking app available right now on App Store.

I have used many Habit tracking apps but without any hesitation I can say, it is the best habit tracking app available on App Store. The app has got everything that a user would need. With cloud backup, it works on all three devices : iPhone, Mac, watch.

The developer is providing frequent updates to app and constantly improving it. Also, developer always respond back to users suggestions and feedbacks.

The app is a perfect package of all important features. I have not encountered any bugs so far. Have used the app for more than a year. Writing this review to appreciate the developer’s hard work.

There are just three things that I think can be added to the app :
1) Please add jump rope workout under Apple health integration habits. Already mailed developer on this and he has acknowledged it. Hope to see this addition pretty soon.
2) I feel the developer can add more statistics. You can add comparison graphs, longest streak bar graphs, you can show which habits are most active, which are neutral and which are stalled. You can improve and add more heat maps. Currently, I personally feel the statistics are little less.
3) The most important suggestion is to have weekly, monthly and yearly habit reports. It can give user great insight for every habit. Along with that, you can implement something like Spotify wrapped. User should be able to get a photo of monthly/yearly recap, which contains maybe heat maps, or some other stats clearly depicting the progress made at the end of a month and at the end of year. User can share that picture on social media. It’s a Win Win situation for both parties. User will get more motivation from this, and it will help developer to promote the app.

I usually do not write such long reviews, but the app is so awesome that I had to write one. Kudos to developer for all the effort in creating and maintaining such a beautiful app. I just hope we get to see the above 3 feature request in near future.

title: Researched 10+ apps & I’m GLAD I chose this!
body:
Did an extensive research for more than 10+ tools before shortlisting this one. This is on the basis of my requirement, budget and other things.

Pros:
-Great UI, the visuals are really appealing & it’s fun to check the dashboard so logging in data everyday becomes effortless. 
-Amazing UX with almost zero learning curve
-Great support, founder is pretty responsive.
-Very Reasonably priced
-Provides the option of backing up the data on the cloud as well as CSV export, which again was important for me.

Cons:
-Web version missing
-Would be better if I had the functionality to check on & compete with my family member on their habits

Suggestions:
-If can add in more options of habits frequency, for example, biweekly, by monthly quarterly, semi annually, annually, that would be great.

Overall for the price, it’s definitely worth it. my life has become much more structured organized and productive after using the app.
